headline: MINUTE CREATURES REPORTED TO THE ROYAL SOCIETY
dispatch: Antonie van Leeuwenhoek of Delft has sent the Royal Society an account of living creatures seen in a drop of water through his small lenses. His observations give the London fellows a startling report from a world too small for the unaided eye.
answer: Leeuwenhoek describes protozoa to the Royal Society, 1676
